content: Fonts verified for Bulgarian Cyrillic via fontTools GSUB parse + HarfBuzz shaping: Sofia Sans (Lettersoup/Botio Nikoltchev, OFL, GF v20) has cyrl/RUS locl with 30 .loclRUS substitutions meaning DEFAULT outlines are Bulgarian; renders Bulgarian forms with lang=bg, lang=en or no lang. Manrope cyrl:[BGR,SRB] 23 .loclBGR subs. Montserrat cyrl:[BGR,BSH,CHU,MKD,SRB] 23 subs. Commissioner cyrl:[BGR,BSH,CHU,SRB] 22 subs. Google Fonts' pre-subset cyrillic woff2 files RETAIN the locl tables (verified on Sofia Sans 25.6KB and Manrope 14.5KB subsets). Fira Sans as shipped on Google Fonts has NO cyrl script (the 62-alternate claim applies to upstream FiraGO/bBoxType build, not the GF build). Onest has cyrl script but no BGR langsys.
